description: Rich capability cards for Stage 6 mini-RAG: each job links to access surfaces, SQL databases/models/key fields, API checks, activities, observables, failures, and role paths. Constrained tag IDs remain the taxonomy capability id list; this file is reference enrichment.

ground_truth_principle.statement: WCS SQL (Helix/SSMS) is the authoritative backend state store for all operational surfaces. RMS, Ignition, AVEVA, the hospital HMI, and the WCS API are interfaces that read from or write to WCS SQL; they do not hold independent state.
